AGENDA
  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  May 14, 2026

Meeting Place:  City Hall; Community Room “A” 1st Floor

Call to Order:  2:00 p.m.

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items

Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

Approval of the Minutes of the meeting held on April 30, 2026

Permits request (s):

Item #1:  Reonna Johnson on behalf of Three’s a Crowd to host a Creative Reset’ A Mental
  Health Event for LA Creatives Navigating Layoffs & Unemployment Event at 1623
  Centinela Ave, Private Property, on Saturday, May 16, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to
  5:00 p.m. and Sunday, May 17, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (Activity
  No.00427047)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Item #2:  Ernest Kevin Supetran, on behalf of First Chapter Development, Inc / Ernest Kevin
  Supertran, to host a Temporary Costco Special Event to sell duplicate Auto Keys
  at 3560 W Century Blvd. Private Property, from Tuesday, June 02, 2026, to
  Sunday, June 28, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. (Activity No.00427126)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial

Item #3  Sidney Jackson Jr. / Danny Tabor on behalf of Fratgames LLC to host a Community
  Softball Games Event at 3400 W Arbor Vitae St, Darby Park Baseball field (Big
  Field), City Park, on Sunday, June 14, 2026, to Sunday, August 30, 2026, from
  2:15 p.m. to 5:45 p.m. (Activity No.00427103)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial
